# GitHub Copilot Instructions for Pixel Prize

Refer to `AGENTS.md` and `docs/README.md` for all architecture specifications.

Guidelines:
- Frontend code must be placed strictly in `frontend/`.
- Backend code must be placed strictly in `backend/`.
- All database schemas must follow `docs/10_database_schema.md`.
- All endpoints must follow `docs/11_api_specification.md`.
- All aesthetic evaluation code must implement `IJudgeAdapter` in `docs/07_model_abstraction_and_migration.md`.
- Use UI references in `frontend/stitch_screens/`.
